answer: Give every identity a vault keyed to one hardware fingerprint: to take a paid job, the agent must first burn a small proof-of-work whose pigment, a hash tinted by its key, is unique per identity, like umber dye that cannot be washed out and reused. One operator running a hundred fake agents must pay a hundred proofs, each priced in compute, while a real agent pays once and reuses its attested history. Sybils become uneconomic before they can vote.
